intro: Your temporary email is ready when you are. No signup, no strings, no clutter.
empty: Anything sent to your temporary address will appear here automatically.
safety: Keep it temporary. Never use this inbox for banking, sensitive accounts, or password recovery.
privacyText: A private address for the things that don’t need your permanent one.
feature1text: Skip the signup. Copy your address and use it wherever temporary email is accepted.
feature2text: Your browser holds a private access key. Keep your recovery token to yourself.
feature3text: Inboxes expire automatically. Delete yours earlier whenever you like.
usernameHint: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore. Must start with a letter or number.
usernameTaken: That username is not available. Try a different one.
recoveryNote: Save this somewhere private. It is shown once and lets anyone holding it restore your inbox.
imagesWarning: Loading images can reveal your IP address to the sender.
confirmDelete: Delete this inbox and all its messages? This cannot be undone.
confirmNew: Create another address? Save your recovery token first if you need to return to this inbox.
required: Complete the security check to create your inbox.
expired: This inbox has expired. Create a new address to continue.
service: The mail service is unavailable. Please try again shortly.
tooMany: You have created several addresses recently. Please wait a little while before creating another one.
footer: Temporary mail. Lasting peace of mind.
emptySearch: Try a different sender or subject.
about: A fresh address, a clean inbox.
step2: Use it for a one-time signup
stepText: Your inbox updates automatically. No need to keep pressing refresh.
addressOnly: This QR code shares your email address only. It does not grant inbox access.
recoveryUnavailable: Recovery tokens are shown only when an address is created. Create a new address to receive a new token.
privateNote: This inbox is private. Only this browser or your recovery token can open it.
compose: Send an email from this address
composeNote: Plain text only. Replies reach this inbox only while it is active. A footer identifies the message as sent from a temporary address.
composeInternalOnly: Right now this address can only send to other temporary addresses hosted here.
subject: Subject
sentEmpty: Messages you send from this address will be listed here.
sendDisabled: Sending is turned off on this site.
sendUnavailable: Sending is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
recipientBlocked: That recipient cannot be reached from this service.
messageBlocked: The message contains content that is not allowed.
deliveryFailed: The email could not be delivered. Try again later.
sendLimit: Sending limit reached for this inbox. Try again later.
